verdict.rationale: Granola documents that users choose which note access scopes to include when creating an API key, which directly supports issuing scoped credentials. It also offers workspace-level API keys that admins can create, and its API docs explicitly position the API for building custom AI agents. Scope granularity is only described as 'note access scopes', and workspace keys don't expire, which weakens the least-privilege story. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of scope granularity (e.g., read vs. write, per-folder), key expiry/rotation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
